lesson.title: 6.2 Transportation
lesson.unit_outcome: Name places in town and ways to travel, say where places are, give simple directions, say what you can and cannot do, ask for help, and read simple bus and train times.
lesson.goal: Recognize a train and a taxi, say how I go with by, and say that I walk.
lesson.grammar_function: I go by bus. I go to work by train. The children walk to school.
lesson.prerequisite: 2.2 bus, car and bike; 4.6 go to school and go to work; 1.4 children.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say how I go to work or school.
